messages.subject: timeDate package for renjin
parts:
Hi guys,

I have to use timeDate package in renjin, but due to error in build (http://packages.renjin.org/packages/timeDate.html) i can't download and use it.

So I downloaded sources from http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/timeDate/index.html and try use renjin maven plugin to build new one.

I have got this error: 

INFO] --- renjin-maven-plugin:0.7.0-RC7:namespace-compile (default-cli) @ timeDate ---
Evaluating '/home/fujdiar/workspace/renjin-packages/timeDate/src/main/R/AllClass.R'
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] BUILD FAILURE
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[INFO] Total time: 0.707s
[INFO] Finished at: Wed Jan 07 12:36:02 CET 2015
[INFO] Final Memory: 8M/235M
[INFO] ------------------------------------------------------------------------
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal org.renjin:renjin-maven-plugin:0.7.0-RC7:namespace-compile (default-cli) on project timeDate: exception: InvocationTargetException: Exception evaluating AllClass.R: could not find function 'setClass' -> [Help 1]
[ERROR] 
[ERROR] To see the full stack trace of the errors, re-run Maven with the -e switch.
[ERROR] Re-run Maven using the -X switch to enable full debug logging.
[ERROR] 
[ERROR] For more information about the errors and possible solutions, please read the following articles:
[ERROR] [Help 1] http://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/MAVEN/MojoExecutionException


Is this procedure OK?
Is it possible to build own package from timeDate sources?

thanks
Stanley

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: timeDate package for renjin
parts:
Hello Stanley,

thanks for getting in touch! Unfortunately, you will not be able to use this package as it depends on the methods package (e.g. the setClass function) and this package has not yet been ported to Renjin. We understand that this is a rather important package to be missing and we hope to start work on this soon.

I have no experience with the Maven plugin, but my guess is that this is indeed the correct way to compile GNU R packages for Renjin. You can test this by using a rather simple package such as http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/exptest/index.html

Regards,

Maarten-Jan

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: timeDate package for renjin
parts:
Hi Tomas,
Sorry for the late response,

Renjin's S4 implementation still has some issues, notably during package loading, which are probably affecting this package. 

The output you see on packages.renjin.org is from building the original source package from CRAN:

http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/timeDate/index.html

You can grab the sources from CRAN and step through the namespace evaluation step to see where things are going wrong. 

Best,
Alex
